name: veterinary_clinic_system_003_vaccination_reminder_batch
instruction: Run the overdue-vaccination reminder batch for the episode. The reminder queue is not authoritative for who is overdue — some overdue patients have no queued reminder, and the queue also holds non-vaccination kinds you must leave untouched. For every patient whose earliest overdue vaccination (due_date strictly before the episode date) is not already covered by a queued vaccination_due reminder, push one new reminder_queue row with kind='vaccination_due', status='queued', queued_by='admin@pawsclinic.com', due_date equal to that earliest overdue due, message '<PatientName> is overdue for <vaccine_type> — call to book a nurse visit.', and vaccine_type set on the row. If a patient has multiple overdue vaccines, pick the one with the earliest due_date; break ties by the alphabetically first vaccine_type. For each newly queued patient, push one outbound email communications row to the owner with patient_id set: subject='Vaccination reminder <batch_code>', body='<PatientName> is overdue for <vaccine_type> as of <episode date YYYY-MM-DD>.', logged_by='system', occurred_at=episode. Then write the batch report: one ops_reports row per vaccine_type with report='vaccination_reminder_batch', batch_code, and reminder_count; plus an 'ALL' rollup. Finally append one audit_log entry with action='VACCINATION_REMINDER_BATCH', actor='system', actor_role='system', target_collection='reminder_queue', target_id=<batch_code>, details summarizing the counts, and occurred_at=episode. Leave all seeded reminder_queue, communications, and audit_log rows untouched.
_max_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session (anti-brute-force); this session cannot run against a container
_par_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session; placeholder only

success_criteria.summary: Expected set = patients with any vaccination due<ep, minus patients already having a queued vaccination_due reminder. For each expected patient, exactly one new reminder_queue row with the earliest overdue (due, then alphabetical vaccine_type) and one new communications row keyed by (subject, patient_id). ops_reports holds one row per vaccine_type plus an 'ALL' rollup, all counts matching a raw Python filter and an independent SQL GROUP BY. Exactly one new audit_log row for the batch. Seeded rows in touched collections unchanged; all other collections canary-intact.

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside the declared blast_radius

checks.expect: seeded 4 rows unchanged; one new row per expected patient with correct due_date, message, and vaccine_type
per-vaccine-type reminder counts and total computed two independent ways (Python + SQL GROUP BY/COUNT) and matched to ops_reports

hazards: existing queued vaccination_due rows for patient 2 (Pepper, canine) and patient 5 (Clementine, feline) must not be duplicated and their owners must not get a second communication.
reminder_queue decoys: id 3 is invoice_overdue (status='sent') and id 4 is boarding_checkin (status='queued'); an over-broad 'flip anything queued' or 'count all queued' solution touches these.
overdue patients span all species (canine, feline, avian, exotic, equine); a canine-only filter misses roughly half the expected set.
tie-breaking: when a patient has multiple overdue vaccines, the chosen vaccine_type is the earliest due_date then alphabetically first vaccine_type, not the first row returned by the API.
multi-pet owners: one owner may have multiple overdue pets; communications must be one per patient (keyed by patient_id), not one per owner.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Combines a reconciliation sweep against an incomplete queue with a multi-channel owner notification and a per-vaccine-type batch report, all under one episode batch code. Requires deriving the overdue set from live vaccinations, respecting existing queued rows, and producing idempotent, dual-path-verified aggregate outputs. No public benchmark fuses these four collections in a single reminder mission.
